title: 第1405章 寄生虫第1404章 独门材料
slug: 厨神把师姐们喂成女帝
content_zh:
“没事，就算是宝贝你也自己决定如何处置，现在城内是天盟说了算。”
林东方先给掌柜吃了定心丸，才接过储物袋查看。
打开一看，他有些傻眼。
居然是一个黑色的大土堆！
“不对，不是土…”
林东方捏出一点土在指尖捻了捻，疑惑的看向掌柜，“这好像是锅底灰吧？”
掌柜听到这话后也一愣，思考片刻后脸上露出恍然之色，
“前辈您这么一说，那还真就应该是锅底灰，当时我出去历练，意外坠入一个很深的矿洞，那是个很大很大的地下空间，里面只有三块巨石，现在想想，那三块巨石应该就是一个灶坑。”
“这些黑土是我从那些石头上刮下来的，一开始只发现能治疗中毒，后来偶然一次把它和辣椒一起炼祛湿的丹药，发现特别辣，就用来做菜了。”
林东方听到这不由得说道，“你还真机灵，这锅底灰足够你用很多年了。”
锅底灰做菜倒也没啥，像是烤地瓜、土豆，哪个上面没有点锅底灰？
而且用量也不大，拳头大的一团加在调料里，足够这家店用半年了。
沈倾月在一边听完这材料的特殊性，认真想了想后说道，
“我打算以寂雪域天盟的名义开一家灵宝阁，可以寄存或者寄售天材地宝，这锅底灰可以存在我们的灵宝阁，掌柜你每个月或者每年过来取一些，倒也不遭人惦记。”
掌柜听完后大喜过望，连连拱手道，“沈盟主所言极是，我也有意将此物寄存出去。”
他又取出地图在某处标记了一下，递给林东方说道，
“前辈，这里便是我发现锅底灰的遗迹，那地下隧道入口是个小山洞，位于这片山岭的第九高山的正南方向。”
“多谢。”
林东方取出一瓶保命的丹药递给掌柜。
“前辈，这使不得！”

掌柜连连推辞，今天要不是有林东方在此，他一家老小估计就要被扔进丹盟大牢了。
“此事对我来说非同小可，你收着吧。”
林东方笑着把丹瓶塞进掌柜怀里，“我们继续吃饭了。”
“多谢前辈，多谢前辈！”
掌柜连连施礼，揣着丹瓶离开雅间。
林东方看了看地图，是在寂雪域西边的一处群山中。
他对还在埋头猛吃的两女说道，“此事赶早不赶晚，我先去一趟，你们两位这两天辛苦些，依旧还是要全力准备春耕。”
“师叔放心，我大夏国今年绝对是寂雪域第一产粮大户！”
帝圣心十分有信心的挥了挥拳头，大司农杜正被林东方治好后，又生龙活虎的投入到了农业工作中，让她省了不少心。
沈倾月点头道，“我会发布事务让天盟的人关注风云气象，能行云布雨或者疏通洪水的，可以积累功绩换取一些功法。”
天材地宝也许总一天会消耗完，但功法抄本多了去了。
“如此我就放心了，辛苦你们了。”
林东方笑着离开雅间，直奔西边去了。
雅间里，帝圣心噘噘嘴说道，“师叔对咱们也太客气了，搞得咱们好像是被他请来帮忙的一样。”
沈倾月微微一笑，“师叔的脾气就是这样啦，对师父也是这样的。”
“真怀疑他对道侣是不是也这样。”
content_en:
"It's okay. Even if it's a treasure, you decide what to do with it yourself. Now the Tianmeng has the final say in the city."
Lin Dongfang gave the shopkeeper reassurance before taking the storage bag and checking it.
When he opened it, he was a little dumbfounded.
It turned out to be a big black mound!
"No, it's not soil..."
Lin Dongfang pinched out a little soil and rolled it on his fingertips, then looked at the shopkeeper doubtfully, "This seems to be the ash at the bottom of the pot, right?"
The shopkeeper was stunned when he heard this. After thinking for a moment, a look of surprise appeared on his face.
"Senior, if you say so, it really should be the ashes at the bottom of the pot. I went out for training and accidentally fell into a very deep mine. It was a very large underground space with only three huge rocks in it. Now that I think about it, those three huge rocks should be a stove pit."
"I scraped this black soil from those stones. At first, I only found it could cure poisoning. Later, I accidentally mixed it with chili peppers to make an elixir for removing dampness. I found it to be very spicy, so I used it in cooking."
When Lin Dongfang heard this, he couldn't help but said, "You are really smart. The ashes in the pot will be enough for you to use for many years."
There is nothing wrong with cooking with pot ash, such as roasted sweet potatoes or potatoes. Which one doesn't have pot ash on it?
And the amount is not large, a fist-sized lump added to the seasoning is enough for this store for half a year.
Shen Qingyue listened to the special nature of this material, thought about it carefully and said,
"I plan to open a Lingbao Pavilion in the name of Jingxue Tianmeng, where we can store or sell heavenly materials and earthly treasures. The ashes from the pot can be stored in our Lingbao Pavilion. Shopkeeper, you can come here every month or every year to pick up some, and no one will worry about it."
After hearing this, the shopkeeper was overjoyed. He cupped his hands and said, "What Chief Shen said is true. I also intend to store this thing."
He took out the map again and marked somewhere, handed it to Lin Dongfang and said,
"Senior, this is where I found the remains of the ashes at the bottom of the pot. The entrance to the underground tunnel is a small cave, located due south of the ninth highest mountain in this mountain range."
"Thank you."
Lin Dongfang took out a bottle of life-saving elixir and handed it to the shopkeeper.
"Senior, this is impossible!"
The shopkeeper refused repeatedly. If Lin Dongfang hadn't been here today, his whole family would have been thrown into the Danmeng prison.
"This matter is not trivial to me, so just accept it."
Lin Dongfang smiled and stuffed the elixir bottle into the shopkeeper's arms, "Let's continue eating."
"Thank you, senior, thank you, senior!"
The shopkeeper saluted repeatedly and left the private room with the elixir bottle.
Lin Dongfang looked at the map and saw that it was in the mountains to the west of Silent Snow Region.
He said to the two women who were still immersed in eating, "It's sooner rather than later. I'll go there first. You two have been working harder these two days, but you still have to prepare for spring plowing with all your strength."
"Uncle, don't worry, our Daxia country will definitely be the largest grain producer in the Silent Snow Region this year!"
Emperor Shengxin waved her fist with great confidence. After Da Sinong Duzheng was cured by Lin Dongfang, she returned to agricultural work vigorously, which saved her a lot of worry.
Shen Qingyue nodded and said, "I will announce the affairs to let the people of Tianmeng pay attention to the situation. Those who can make clouds and rain or dredge floods can accumulate merits in exchange for some skills."
The treasures of heaven, materials and earth may be used up in one day, but there are too many copies of the exercises.
"That puts me at ease. Thank you for your hard work."
Lin Dongfang left the private room with a smile and went straight to the west.
In the private room, Emperor Shengxin pouted and said, "Uncle Master is too polite to us, making it seem like we were invited by him to help."
Shen Qingyue smiled slightly and said, "This is how Uncle Master's temper is, and he treats Master the same way."
"I really wonder if he treats fellow Taoists like this too."
